title: Stable-MM-R1: Anchoring Multimodal Reasoning Dynamics via Entropy-Guided Stratification
abstract: arXiv:2609.07148v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: While Reinforcement Learning (RL) effectively incentivizes reasoning in Large Language Models, current pipelines are hindered by training instability and rapid entropy collapse. These limitations often stem from "Rollout Silencing" and low-quality gradient signals in standard sampling procedures. In this work, we propose a robust, data-centric framework to stabilize RL training. We first introduce Potential-Aware Query Mining (PAQM), which filters data dynamically to focus on the "Distillation Zone"---samples with high potential for capability elicitation. Furthermore, we present Hybrid Stratified Replay (HSR), a novel mechanism that restructures batches by stratifying rollouts based on Path Entropy, a rollout-level confidence proxy, and outcome reward. translated_title: Stable-MM-R1：通过熵引导分层锚定多模态推理动态
translated_abstract: 虽然强化学习（RL）能有效激励大型语言模型的推理能力，但当前的训练流程受到训练不稳定性和快速熵坍缩的阻碍。这些限制通常源于标准采样过程中的"Rollout 静默"（Rollout Silencing）和低质量的梯度信号。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个稳健的、以数据为中心的框架来稳定强化学习训练。我们首先引入了潜能感知查询挖掘，该方法动态过滤数据，以聚焦于"蒸馏区"（Distillation Zone）——即具有高能力激发潜力的样本。此外，我们提出了混合分层重放，这是一种新颖的机制，通过基于路径熵（Path Entropy，一种 rollout 级别的置信度代理）和结果奖励对 rollout 进行分层来重构批次。在每个优化步骤中，HSR 复用当前策略的"稳定性锚点"（Stability Anchors）和"困难负样本"（Hard Negatives）来构建高对比度优化组，然后在下一步优化前清空其缓冲区。
tldr: 该论文提出 Stable-MM-R1 框架，通过潜能感知查询挖掘（PAQM）动态筛选高能力激发潜力的样本，并结合基于路径熵与结果奖励分层的混合分层重放（HSR）机制构建高对比度优化组，从而解决多模态强化学习训练中的熵坍缩与不稳定问题。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Stable-MM-R1, a data-centric framework that stabilizes multimodal RL training by combining Potential-Aware Query Mining (PAQM) to dynamically filter high-potential samples with Hybrid Stratified Replay (HSR), which builds high-contrast optimization groups via entropy-guided stratification, thereby addressing entropy collapse and training instability.
